judged_text: totalPages computes `Math.floor(this.get("user_count") / this.get("limit")) + 1`, which overstates the page count by one whenever user_count is an exact multiple of limit (50 members at limit 50 yields totalPages 2 when one page exists; 100 yields 3 when two exist), so `showingLast` (Discourse.computed.propertyEqual("currentPage", "totalPages")) leaves the `next` action enabled on the last real page and the admin clicks through to an empty phantom page (offset clamped to user_count by next's Math.min, server returns zero members, UI shows "2/2" or "3/3" with an empty member list) — the correct formula is Math.ceil(user_count/limit). Every group whose member count is divisible by the 50-per-page limit displays an empty phantom page to admins, and since the diff's only test file (spec/controllers/admin/groups_controller_spec.rb, checked; no spec/javascripts changes exist in the diff) contains no test touching any of the new pagination properties (currentPage/totalPages/next/previous), the off-by-one ships completely unverified.

adjudication.rationale: In `admin-group.js.es6`, `totalPages` is computed as `Math.floor(this.get("user_count") / this.get("limit")) + 1`, which is off by one when `user_count` is an exact multiple of `limit` (e.g., 50/50 => 2). With `next` setting `offset = Math.min(offset + limit, user_count)`, an exact-multiple last page allows `offset` to become `user_count`, and `group.findMembers()` then requests `/groups/:name/members.json` with `offset=user_count`, which (per `GroupsController#members` using `.limit(limit).offset(offset)`) returns an empty `members` array. Since `showingLast` is `propertyEqual("currentPage", "totalPages")`, it will not disable Next on the last real page in these cases, producing a phantom empty page. The suggested fix (`Math.ceil(user_count/limit)`) matches the observed issue in the diff.
